label: kizuna_ecology_b_02
text: I see you’ve already registered 30 species of\nPokémon to your Pokédex for me![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: kizuna_ecology_b_03
text: Wow! So you caught this kind of Pokémon?\nAnd this one?! All this data... This is the best![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: kizuna_ecology_b_04
text: Ah...sorry about that. I got a little excited there.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: kizuna_ecology_b_05
text: But I get the feeling that you’re going to be a\ngreat help in my Pokémon research.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: kizuna_ecology_b_06
text: Here, take these. Consider it my way of saying\nthanks.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: kizuna_ecology_b_07
text: You sure are good at catching Pokémon, aren’t\nyou, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: kizuna_ecology_b_08
text: For your next goal, let’s aim for 100 species![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: kizuna_ecology_b_09
text: Remember—when you find a Pokémon you’ve\nnever seen before, give a Poké Ball a throw![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
